evidence: Modifies test framework P2PConnection logic in test/functional/test_framework/p2p.py to correctly handle chunked reads.
rationale: Fixes a test framework parsing bug where premature header inspection during socket chunking causes p2p_v2_encrypted.py to time out. As documented in tracking issue #36726 and PR #36724, waiting for the full 24-byte header mirrors bitcoind's V1Transport and prevents spurious test failures.
